text:
Nora: Quick heads-up: EU S3 had a transient spike and kafka consumer commits lagged. We've accumulated ~48h of late telemetry that left hourly aggregates stale. I'm proposing a staged rehydrate instead of one big blast. Thoughts?
Omar: +1 on staged. last full-backfill melted our budget when we grabbed whole shards. prefer windowed + sampled approach.
Leah: agree. Also want a pre-launch cost estimate visible in Console. Operators are starting replays blind and then panicking when cost shows up.
Tess: can we apply a dedupe-pass first? run a low-cost TTL/diff compare that filters out keys where aggregate_ts >= event_ts. avoids recomputing unchanged keys.
Ryan: fyi the delayed commits correlate with S3 5xxs; replay runner should tag the source (origin=S3-gap-3111) so we can skip already-committed offsets in future runs. runner currently lacks origin metadata.
sre-bot: incident: ingest-eu-s3-5xx spike 3124998000 resolved ~2h ago.
Nora: good call. My sketch: policy "staggered-rehydrate-v1": A) hot window = last 8h -> full coverage, atomic commit, canary 1% tenants first; B) warm window = (8h..72h] -> deterministic sample 5-15% by tenant, partial commits allowed, capped per-tenant concurrency; C) cold window >72h -> skip unless manual. Include backfill_id header for tracing and dry-run API that returns estimates.
Omar: deterministic sampling is a must. Example: floor(mod(hash(tenant_id || hour), 100)) < sample_pct. That keeps reruns reproducible.
Leah: UX: console dry-run should show estimate_cpu_hours, estimate_rows_touched, est_s3_gb, est_duration. Also an "auto-abort if cost > $X" checkbox.
Tess: prototype selector SQL that works with our index: 
```
selector_sql: |
  SELECT tenant_id, hour
  FROM telemetry_hour_index
  WHERE hour > now() - interval '72 hours'
    AND (abs(hash_text(concat(tenant_id, hour))) % 100) < 10 -- 10% sample
```
It plugs into the job runner and is deterministic.
Ryan: add per-tenant fairness: max_slots_per_tenant = 3 for warm window and global_warm_concurrency = 40. Otherwise a single mega-tenant eats the sample.
Mia: also add a dry-run that can optionally simulate dedupe savings (i.e., estimate how many rows dedupe would skip) so Console can show a lower-cost projection.
Omar: +1. Also request that the job emit a trace header `x-replay-backfill-id` and push that into traces and billing logs so we can correlate spike events.
Leah: testing: we need an eval harness run on canary tenants comparing pre/post aggregate deltas for a set of golden queries. If regression > threshold, auto-rollback or stop.
Tess: can do. I'll add a job flag `regression_check: {enabled:true, threshold:0.5%}`. If enabled, runner runs evals after canary partial commits.
Nora: for the hot-window atomic commit, runtime should lock the hourly partition to avoid serving read anomalies. That means short lock windows and an outage notice in Console.
Ryan: locking is fine, but implement optimistic swap: write to staging table then swap pointer atomically. Less blocking for readers.
sre-bot: runbook snippet: if replay backlog > 400 and low-priority queue occupies > 70% of workers, auto-scale down low-priority to 0 and alert on-call.
console-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /api/replay/dryrun -> payload: {"policy_yaml": "<yaml>"} returns {"estimate_cpu_hours":"12.3","estimate_s3_gb":"45.1","rows_touched":"1.2M","sample_count":"12345"}.
Omar: small edge: ensure watermarking uses event_ingest_time not arrival_time. otherwise we may keep replaying the same late-arrival storms and oscillate.
Leah: devex asks for a one-click Console template named "EU staggered rehydrate" with prefilled policy and warnings. Also show a compact progress bar + per-hour commit status.
Tess: adding selector + unit tests now. will make sample_rate configurable per-tenant override.
Mia: timeline: I can hook Console dry-run UI + auto-abort checkbox today. Nora, can you own the backfill config and trace header?
Nora: yep, I'll assemble the YAML and push a config draft. Draft config below for ops to trial: 
```
policy: staggered_rehydrate_v1
hot_window: 8h
warm_window: 72h
hot_coverage: 100%
warm_sample_pct: 10
max_slots_per_tenant_warm: 3
global_warm_concurrency: 40
allow_partial_commit_warm: true
hot_commit_mode: atomic
trace_header: x-replay-backfill-id
auto_abort_cost_threshold_usd: 500
regression_check_enabled: true
```
Omar: LGTM. please include sample_seed in YAML so sample is stable across runs.
Nora: will do. I'll post PR and tag folks.
Ryan: I'll add origin tagging + staging-swap commit in runner. ETA EOD.
Tess: PR incoming with deterministic selector and unit tests. ETA tomorrow AM.
Leah: I'll draft the Console copy and warning banner for EU-late-ingest.
Mia: once dry-run is live, let's run the canary for the hot-window on 1% tenants, check regressions and cost, then promote.
Nora: perfect. If anything blocks, ping #eng-sre or escalate. I'll post the PR link when ready. :rocket:
